# Metadata

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Structured data that describes, identifies, or provides context for another resource, such as a note, concept, or file.

## Scope note

Covers Obsidian YAML frontmatter properties, SKOS annotation properties, and similar descriptive attributes. Does not cover the content/body of a resource itself.
